_comment: Skill Repo Spec v1 s9 -- every path in this repo belongs to exactly one class.
TOOL    = code, SKILL.md, docs, reference data. Public.
FIXTURE = lifelike test data, produced only by tools/make_fixtures.py. A real record cannot be
regenerated, so pasting a real chat row in fails at commit.
DATA    = anything a REAL RUN produced. Never git-tracked. Lives in the private companion
config, resolved at runtime by tools/datadir.py. This repo ships only the schema.
data_sealed = a path that HELD real data, was purged, and must stay dead.
Enforced by tools/data_boundary.py in .githooks and in CI.
_audited: 2026-08-30 FIRST AUDIT. The single highest-stakes output of this skill is a person's entire QQ chat history, verbatim, including one-on-one messages. The exporter writes decoded messages as JSON. Every landing directory the skill can write to is declared below and sealed, so that a real run cannot deposit chat history at a repo-relative path even with `git add -f`. All entries are directory-form and owe no .example: there is no single shape to publish for a whole export tree. The pulled encrypted database (qq_db_pull/) is equally real-run input and is sealed for the same reason.
_fixture_note: No fixture file is committed. tools/make_fixtures.py builds a synthetic database into a temp directory at test time (see tools/test_qq.py), so there is no on-disk fixture that a real record could hide inside. The generator hardcodes only synthetic accounts and self-evidently fake text.
_data_home: ~/.qq-history-export-config/data/   (override with $QQ_HISTORY_EXPORT_DATA_DIR). If this skill records real-run output, it goes THERE -- never back into this repo.
